summary: Unify version identity and close autonomy payload validation (#384)

architecture.decision: Resolve runtime version from declared constant in checkout mode and matched distribution metadata in installed wheels without breaking lazy CLI/testql imports; inspect runtime version constants via AST and surface explicit #303/#329 distribution blockers in release_availability; enforce extra=forbid, strict field validation, schema versions, and machine-readable field_path 422 errors on autonomy mutation/admission payloads while preserving legacy PATCH partial semantics and legacy Strategy YAML reader; and explicitly separate autodo.planfile-import/v1 from subactor.compiled-work-plan/v1.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; persistent ticket YAML/SQLite storage formats and legacy Strategy YAML loader remain unchanged.

nonGoals: Modifying pyproject.toml or planfile/release-metadata.json already at 0.1.127
Faking or guessing procache PyPI releases tracked in #303 and #329
delivery.outcome: Package version, runtime /health, CLI --version, and OpenAPI report unified 0.1.127 identity with build SHA and capability metadata, and autonomy mutation, comparative admission, and delivery-plan boundaries fail closed on invalid fields or import envelopes.

validation.evidence: Verified consistent 0.1.127 version and source identity across checkout and distribution wheel layouts, CLI --version, /health, and /openapi.json, plus lazy TestQL import preservation.

Verified AST detection of stale runtime __version__ constants in __init__.py and version_identity.py while keeping minimal synthetic fixtures passing (tests/test_release_availability.py + tests/test_ci_readiness.py passed).

Verified 422 pre-write refusal with machine-readable field_path on extra fields, typos, nested section extras, wrong dependency/boolean types, and unsupported schema versions; partial PATCH semantics and 150 total regression tests passed.
Verified load_strategy_yaml and SchemaValidator.validate_yaml_file retain explicit legacy Strategy support while native materialize/preflight/admit refuse legacy payloads with zero writes.
Verified preflight_delivery_plan, POST /delivery-plans/preflight, and materialize_delivery_plan isolate autodo.planfile-import/v1 from subactor.compiled-work-plan/v1 and enforce extra=forbid on both.

Verified qualify_distribution_install reports qualified_full_offline_install=False and [#303, #329] blockers for subactor-procache VCS dependency and never equates minimal SDK import with offline install qualification; ruff check passed.
